hints.title: Span and Uniqueness Invariants
hints.text: An array of length n contains consecutive integers if and only if all elements are distinct and max(nums) - min(nums) == n - 1.

hints.title: Consecutive Verification One-Liner

complexity.notes: Single pass to determine min, max, and set uniqueness.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting the array takes O(n log n), whereas set and extrema check runs in O(n).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate utilizes the math invariants len(set) == n and max - min == n - 1.
